title: Weird behavior from editing a script while an await is occuring
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.3, 4.4 dev 7

### System information

Godot v4.4.dev7 - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 18 Jan 2025 02:26:57 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Single-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (TGL GT2) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1135G7 @ 2.40GHz (8 threads)

### Issue description

Editing and saving a script, which usually triggers a dynamic refresh, crashes the editor with an array of errors if an `await` statement is used.

The specific errors seems to depend on what is being awaited.
First discovered in one of my games, I get this error:
`Internal script error! Opcode: 0 (please report).`
With a new, empty project in 4.3 and 4.4dev7, this error appears:
`Stack Underflow (Engine Bug)`

Either way, the stack underflow only triggers after the `await` has finished.

Further testing is needed to determine whether this error only occurs if a signal from the main tree is awaited (for example, `get_tree().process_frame`, or `get_tree().create_timer(5).timeout`), or whether this happens everywhere (i.e. `await some_node.some_function`)

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new project
2. Add a script to an empty scene, with some form of `await` function (MRP uses `await get_tree().process_frame` in `_process()`
3. Run the project, then *while the project is running*, edit the script in any way (for example, adding a new, empty function)
4. Crash

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18500194/mrp.zip)
